title: Decoding vertex value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet $\text{Fin}(q)$, let $T$ be a table assigning a Boolean function to each vertex, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and choose a default label in $\text{Fin}(q)$. At a vertex $v$, the decoding vertex value is the expectation over neighbors $w$ of $v$ of the decoding edge value for $(v,w)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A Boolean-function table indexed by vertices
caveat: The edge value and neighbor probability law are not defined in the supplied context.
